Synthetic Language Review 2023;5(2):88-104

Scaling Laws for Synthetic Language Models

Rebecca Klein, Omar Haddad
Synthetic Language Lab, University of Examples

Published 2023
DOI: 10.5555/synth.2023.080

Abstract
We study scaling laws for synthetic language models across compute budgets.
Model families from 10M to 10B parameters are evaluated.
Fits are reported for loss versus tokens and parameters.
